verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a driveItem delta endpoint that tracks changes to a driveItem and its children over time [onedrive-docs-21]. Its delta query (change tracking) returns newly created, updated, or deleted entities without a full read of the resource on every request [onedrive-docs-6]. This is exactly the incremental-sync capability the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the cursor/token mechanics (deltaLink/state token, token expiry, resync behavior) in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delta sync in practice.
